answer: We present a cryptanalytic treatment of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, underpinned by verifiable delay functions and quartz-secure leader sortition, thereby establishing a velvet barrier to identity spoofing; assuming a mesa of honest majority nodes, our construction achieves information-theoretic unforgeability, harnessing sequential delay functions to thwart cloning attempts, and culminating in a Byzantine fault-tolerant protocol ensuring cryptographic finality.
